text:
anna: Quick Q — trying to map symptoms from a customer report to the right pool-level dashboards. Where do I find per-pool autoscale history + the KV cache lag traces for EU prod pools? TL;DR: need graphs for autoscale events, pod/node saturation, kv_cache_hit_rate, and per-pool p95 latency. Thanks.

jordan: For dashboards go to Observability > Dedicated Pools > Pool Overview. Direct grafana link (may require VPN): https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/POOL_OVERVIEW?var-pool=eu-prod . Autoscale events live in Loki/Logs and Prometheus events; look for `infra.autoscaler.events{pool="eu-prod"}`. For traces check Jaeger service=autoscaler, operation=ScaleUp.

sanjeev: quick Loki example you can paste into Explore: 
```
{job="k8s-pool", pool="eu-prod"} |= "scale" | json | line_format "{{.timestamp}} {{.message}}"
```
Prometheus metrics: `pool.kv_cache_lag_seconds` for KV lag. p95 latency: 
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{pool="eu-prod"}[5m])) by (le))
```
Those should get you the graphs.

lia: +1 to sanjeev. Short oncall checklist: 1) check `pool.saturation` and CPU steal, 2) check KV cache hit ratio (`pool.kv_cache_hit_rate`), 3) scan autoscaler events for failures/timeouts, 4) trace slow requests back to model-backend spans. I'll paste a trimmed runbook snippet into the pool playbook after. cc @anna

anna: Perfect. Also can someone look at the alert noise? We get a lot of transient alerts for `pool_saturation_high` on EU — thinking to add a 5m hold and bump threshold to 80%. Any objections?

jordan: I opened a short PR and moved it to warning for now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-monitoring/pull/2204 — left notes about window=5m and threshold=80%. Please review.

sanjeev: I'm fine with 80%/5m but suggest a composite: only page SRE if `pool_saturation_high` AND `pool.kv_cache_lag_seconds > 1`. Otherwise post to #eng-platform with severity=warning. I'll sketch the alert rule in the PR.

deploy-bot: Deployment started for infra-monitoring:pr/2204 by jdoe — status: rolling :rocket:

lia: Thanks — anna, once this lands can you watch alerts for the next 6h and confirm noise drops? If it keeps paging we can add a muted policy for EU prod for 24h while we iterate.

anna: Will monitor and report back by EOD. Appreciate the help :thumbsup:
